title: Concept: OData service metadata published
description: An OData metadata document listing entity sets and properties in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The document names every entity set and its properties, which is a full schema of the data the service exposes, including fields the UI never shows.
applicability: Deployments that render an OData metadata document listing entity sets and properties into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The document names every entity set and its properties, which is a full schema of the data the service exposes, including fields the UI never shows.
